notes.title: [01/23] Urgent Patch
notes.notes:
Dear users, 
An emergency fix patch has been updated.

Of the requests we received over the past day, these are the quickest fixes we could make.

1. Add Cutscene skips
2. Give HP potions at the spawn
3. You can return to the main menu after saving from the pause state
4. Description [Mutant Mode -> Easy Mode]
5. Weaker enemies in the early game

We promise to keep updating the game as best we can to ensure everyone.

Thank you for visiting the department store.

notes.title: DISORDER is set to be released!
notes.notes:
Good news!
DISORDER is set to be released!

Thank you to all who have tried the demo, shared feedback, and reported issues. 
Your support and enthusiasm have been invaluable.

Dear users, we are very happy to be able to meet you at the end of a long journey that started at the end of 2020.

Despite the fact that DISORDER has been tested several times internally in a full process, hardware and software environments vary greatly, and it is still difficult to avoid the emergence of occasional serious problems and the inconvenience that may be caused as a result.

In the subsequent patch on the impact of normal game problems as soon as possible to repair.

In addition, we welcome you to publish gameplay videos or live broadcasts on video sites and open up access to revenue generation.

Finally, thank you for your support.

notes.title: DISORDER Release Date Revealed
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

A new trailer has revealed the release date of DISORDER: January 22, 2025.

Our latest trailer features extensive new gameplay footage and in-game cinematics, all captured on PC.

DISORDER will be available on Windows PC, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S. 
You can now wishlist it on Steam and PS Store.

Thanks to everyone for your support, encouragement, and feedback. 

On January 22 next year, we look forward to seeing you there!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332340/_/

notes.title: Demo Availability Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We would like to express our gratitude for your recent visits. Your support and feedback have been invaluable in our ongoing development.

Please take note that the Disorder Demo will only be available for play until October 21st, 22:00 (PST) / October 22nd, 05:00 (UTC). If you have not yet had the opportunity to visit the Department Store, we encourage you to do so before the deadline.

We extend our appreciation to all who have visited so far. 
The full release at the end of the year will have even more content than the demo, so stay tuned.

Thank you.

We look forward to seeing you at Steam NEXT Fest!

notes.title: 'Disorder: Demo' is here!
notes.notes:
Attention, peers! 

We've been working hard over the past few weeks to bring you a demo.
From Steamdeck play to optimization, to localization, to voice recording - we even tried recording in English... at first.

But that's the beautiful thing about demos. It's all going to get better and better. Anyway, thanks for joining us on this journey. It means a lot to us!

PS: Superheroes should wear skintight suits.

Cheers!
GRUMPY

notes.title: DEMO is coming on October 4th!
notes.notes:
Good day, comrade! 

It’s time to bring a new update.  We’ve been hard at work prepping the demo of <DISORDER>, and I’m happy to say that… it will be available on October 4th!  

It’ll stay up throughout Steam Next Fest in October, and perhaps for a week or two after - we shall see once when we get there.

Meanwhile, let me show you a sneak peek:
In the demo, you will be able to play on the 9F Floor - one of the Nine floors we’ll have in the final version. And growth factors are limited compared to the full version.

Also, there's no NDA for this demo. We're happy for you to stream your playthrough if you'd like, but what we'd really appreciate is your thoughts and feedback as this will help shape our game. 

Please note: This is a pre-alpha version of <DISORDER>, so the performance won't be fully optimized yet! 

Sincerely,
GRUMPY
